open_questions.question: Can a named adaptive compiler use a smaller reachable set than the full multiplicative monoid in its level-LCM bound?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The full-monoid shell exponent cannot decrease, but not every monoid element must be a distinct actual plateau start.
open_questions.first_step: Derive the exact reachable plateau language for one nonhomogeneous target/paid profile and retain every chronological cut.
open_questions.blocked_by: No such reachable-set invariant or resulting full LCM bound is established here.
